items.t: Russia launches massive attack on Ukraine a day after Putin’s meeting with Trump and Xi
items.m: Russian forces attacked Kyiv with missiles and drones overnight November 19–20. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said three bridges were damaged. The Podilsko-Voskresenskyi Bridge is closed to traffic from the right bank to the left. The Darnytskyi and Pivdennyi (Southern) bridges were also damaged. The Pivdennyi Bridge has been hit before. Traffic on the bridge remains restricted to public transit vehicles and other motor vehicles weighing up to 10 metric tons, all traveling from the left bank to the right.

items.t: Russian projectiles hit Poland as NATO tensions rise
items.m: Three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday, prompting NATO to condemn what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. A suspected jet-powered drone and a missile struck separate locations near the Ukrainian border, while another missile crashed just 35 kilometres from an area where European troops are taking part in military exercises. Meanwhile, troops from eight NATO countries are conducting drills in neighbouring Lithuania. With US-led peace talks yet to make a breakthrough, tensions between Europe and Russia remain high. Peter O’Brien reports.
